title: Centro Storico
body: The Pantheon, the piazzas and the coffee that anchors them — Rome at street level, flat and endlessly walkable.

title: Ancient Rome
body: The Colosseum, the Forum and the Campidoglio terrace above it — the two-millennia core, best taken early.

title: Tridente & Trevi
body: Trevi before the crowds or late at night, the Steps, and the Pincio at golden hour.

title: Vatican & Borgo
body: The Museums are a morning discipline; the basilica, the dome and the bridge of angels reward the rest of the day.
image: The dome from Via della Conciliazione

title: Trastevere
body: Cobbles, mosaics, supplì standing up, and the Gianicolo above it all — the evening quarter.

title: Monti & Esquilino
body: The village between the ruins — Via Urbana, the Moses, and the basilicas east of it.

title: Aventine & Testaccio
body: The orange garden and the keyhole, then down to the market Rome actually eats at.

title: Villa Borghese
body: Bernini at the Galleria — the strictest ticket in Rome — and the gardens around it.
